about: The Vintage Circle is at 3828 S Texas Ave in Bryan.

It carries rows of vintage clothing, jewelry and accessories plus hundreds of antiques, with a wide variety of vintage Harley-Davidson, Nike and band t-shirts. Aline Magazine says the staff is always welcoming and excited to give background on their pieces.
Customers have given it 4.6 stars across 59 Google reviews.
